exact.Qué guardamos en tu teléfono: What we store on your phone
exact.Los lugares que marcas con el corazón y: The places you mark with the heart and the city you chose are saved only on this device (local storage). We don't send them to a server.
exact.Si escribes para añadir o corregir un lu: If you write to add or correct a place, we receive the text, the contact details you entered and the photos you attached. That is used only to update the guide.
exact.Las playas con ubicación confirmada se m: Beaches with a confirmed location are shown on an OpenStreetMap map. The other zones stay on Google Maps. Their rules apply there, not ours.
